notices.text: Gauge-based rain datasets confirm a very wet October 2026 in {area} (about 3 to 6 times normal) but not CHIRPS's totals, which are higher than any other final dataset; the highest cells are unconfirmed.
All other rain datasets confirm a very wet October 2026 in {area} (2 to 3 times normal); their totals differ by a factor of two or more, so rankings are uncertain.
